$comment: The pages no longer embed a font. The woff2 files here are kept because they are
where the inline SVG outlines come from: `python3 scripts/extract-glyphs.py` reads
them and emits the `RZ_GLYPH_PATHS` and `ICON_PATHS` tables the pages carry. Nothing
in `npm run build` reads this directory.
So the workflow for adding an icon is: add the name here, run
`node scripts/fetch-icon-fonts.js` to refetch the subset, then
`python3 scripts/extract-glyphs.py` and paste the new entry into the page's table.
`fill` and `axes` are the instance the outlines were taken at. They are recorded
because a later refetch at a different FILL would silently produce differently
weighted icons beside the existing ones.
tests/golden/icon-subset.test.ts gates the pages, not this file: every name a page
renders must have an outline, and every outline must be rendered.
